cards.question: What are the two sublayers of the Data-Link Layer under IEEE 802?
cards.answer:
1. Logical Link Control (LLC)
2. Media Access Control (MAC)

cards.question: What is the broadcast MAC address representation?
cards.answer: Forty-eight 1s, written in hex as FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF

questions.question: Which sublayer handles flow control under IEEE 802?
questions.explanation: LLC handles flow control and framing (p.116).
